q: When must designated consumers submit RCO energy accounts and compliance reports?
title: RCO deadlines and who certifies the figures
short: Certified energy accounts are due by 31 July each year, and the compliance report, after covering any shortfall with RECs or buyout, by 31 December. For 2024-25 the dates were 31 October 2025 and 31 March 2026, and the Ministry of Power later extended final compliance to 31 May 2026.
audience: Energy managers and compliance teams at designated consumers

ul: FY 2024-25 compliance report: by 31 March 2026, extended to 31 May 2026 by the Ministry of Power letter of 16 April 2026.
FY 2025-26 onwards: energy accounts by 31 July after the year ends, compliance report by 31 December.
Distribution licensees: certified by the State Load Despatch Centre.
Captive users, open access consumers and other designated consumers: certified by an accredited energy auditing firm empanelled by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.
All submissions use the formats in Annexure II of the notification.

p: The Bureau of Energy Efficiency monitors compliance and reports to the Central Government, copying the State Electricity Regulatory Commissions. The Bureau is also to issue detailed implementation guidelines.

example.title: Timeline for FY 2025-26
lines: Buy RECs or pay buyout for any shortfall, then file the compliance report: by 31 December 2026

senseible: Senseible keeps a year of bills and captive generation records in one place with their sources, which shortens the evidence hunt when the energy auditor certifies your RCO accounts.
